description: Azure Key Vault connection-string source for JD.Efcpt.Build. Install alongside JD.Efcpt.Build and set EfcptConnectionStringSource=azure-keyvault to resolve the build-time connection string from a Key Vault secret. See https://jerrettdavis.github.io/JD.Efcpt.Build/user-guide/connection-string-sources.html for details.
title: JD.Efcpt.Build Azure Key Vault Connection-String Source
